heading: Form the future passive

phrases.en: If we stay together we will not get hurt.
The letter will be sent tomorrow morning.

sentences.en: When will you go in?
Don't go in there!
Let's meet up tomorrow.
I will enjoy the movie.
I hope you will enjoy it.
This will end in a wedding.
Then we will meet up every week.
I hope you will enjoy it.
This will look like new.
One day everything will be over.
Do you think that he will stay?
This is a love that will not end.
We are passing in the morning.
I don't want you to get hurt.
Do you think that he will get hurt?
I didn't believe that they would split up.
I will get lost in the forest without a map.
She will stay with us tonight.
The letter will be sent tomorrow morning.
If we stay together we will not get hurt.
The mirror will be sent on Sunday.
My keys will not get lost again!
We will go in when we are all ready.

sentences.he: הם לא ייפרדו, זה הכל שקרים.
sentences.en: They won't split up, it's all lies.

sentences.he: חשוב לי שזה לא ייראה מכוער.
sentences.en: It's important to me that this not look ugly.
I didn't say that he would split up with his wife.

sentences.he: היא תיפגש עם הבמאי ביום שישי.
sentences.en: She will meet up with the director on Friday.

sentences.he: אני בטוח שאני אהנה לעבוד איתכם.
sentences.en: I am sure that I will enjoy working with you.

sentences.he: אחרי הניתוח אני ארָאה שונָה לגמרי.
sentences.en: After the operation I will look completely different.

sentences.he: המכתב יאבד אם לא תכתוב את הכתובת הנכונה.
sentences.en: The letter will get lost if you do not write the correct address.

sentences.he: אם המשטרה לא תמצא אותם, עוד אנשים ייפגעו.
sentences.en: If the police don't find them, more people will be hurt.

sentences.he: אם לא תגיד לי את האמת, כל ההודעות האלה יישלחו למשטרה.
sentences.en: If you won't tell me the truth, all those messages will be sent to the police.

hints.אני: I / I am / I am a girl
hints.מקווה: hope / hopes / i, you, he, it (m.s - pres.)
hints.מקווָה: hope / hopes / i, you, he, it (m.s - pres.)
hints.חושב: I think so / is thinking / think
hints.שלא: that are not / that do not / that is not
hints.תיגמר: (You / she) will come to an end
hints.ביום: a day / in the day / on Friday
hints.שזה: that it is / that this is
hints.שאני: after I / that I / that I am
hints.ארָאה: I will see / I will show, demonstrate
